message.content: {"language":"en","text":"This DOCN monthly accumulation run had a strong outcome, but it was a turbulent ride. The strategy beat SPY by 176.8 percentage points over the historical window, while holding through the run meant accepting a 42.1% peak-to-trough drawdown. That drawdown is a percentage decline from a prior high, not the ending loss. As a starting-capital illustration only, 42.1% of the initial $1,000 would be $421.20, not the portfolio’s actual peak-to-trough dollar loss.\n\nThe main tradeoff was return versus stability: the historical result was far more rewarding than the benchmark, but with much higher variability.
